newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen firmer, but unlikely to extend gains.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen firmer, but unlikely to extend gains.

text.p: The key December three-month Euroyen futures contract was firmer in line with rises in yen bond prices by midday on Monday, but traders said its buoyancy was limited amid a lack of fresh buying incentives.

"December should have risen more, given that it smoothly rose to 99.00 on the CME on Friday," a European bank trader said. However, it failed to extend gains due to a lack of fresh buying incentives, he added.
December was at 98.98 at the end of the morning session, compared with Friday's settlement of 98.95. Most of the gains were in response to firmer Japanese government bond prices.
